subject: BrightPath renewal: term and capacity alignment + QBR scheduling
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Diana Bates <diana.bates@brightpath.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: BrightPath renewal: term and capacity alignment + QBR scheduling

Hi Diana —

Hope you're doing well. With BrightPath's contract coming up at the end of August, I wanted to start a short renewal-origination thread to align on term options, expected seat/throughput increases, and a date for the QBR so we can lock the mutual action plan.

High-level asks from our side:
- Confirm target contract term (12 vs 24 months) and any internal sign-off timeline.
- Expected seat count and anticipated burst GPU hours for H1 FY28.
- Stakeholder list for legal and procurement (names + emails).
- Preferred QBR windows (we can do week of Jul 19 or Aug 2).

Proposed timeline (suggested):
1) This week — finalize stakeholders and pick QBR date.
2) Week of Jul 5 — Redwood to send draft MLA with redlines for legal.
3) Week of Jul 19 — QBR (product roadmap + capacity sizing).
4) Jul 26 — finalize commercial term and prepare DocuSign.

Marissa (AE) is looped to propose commercial options for seat/throughput increases; Sean is cc'd for pricing signoffs. If it helps, I can prepare two term options (12/24) with an upsell worksheet before the QBR.

Attachments: QBR_Agenda_Jul20.docx (draft agenda)

Thanks — let me know who from BrightPath should be on the invite and any firm dates that won't work.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Diana Bates <diana.bates@brightpath.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Lee <tom.lee@brightpath.com>, legal@brightpath.com
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightPath renewal: term and capacity alignment + QBR scheduling

Thanks Alex — appreciate the clear timeline. Quick answers:
- Term: Leadership prefers 24 months this cycle but wants pricing for both 12 and 24.
- Seats: baseline +20% for seats (current: 120 -> target 144) and planning for occasional burst of up to 3x baseline for peak reporting windows.
- Stakeholders: Myself (Diana Bates), Tom Lee (Head of Platform), and our GC (legal@brightpath.com). Tom will handle sizing details during the QBR.

QBR windows: Jul 20 works best for Tom and me; Jul 19 is tight. Aug 2 is okay but we'd prefer July if possible.

Will ask legal to review any draft MLA you share. If your team can send pricing scenarios and a draft agreement week of Jul 5, we should be able to move quickly.

Diana
Director of Data Platforms
BrightPath Analytics

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Diana Bates <diana.bates@brightpath.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 26 Jun 2027 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightPath renewal: term and capacity alignment + QBR scheduling

Morning — looping in Priyom from Customer Success for migration/ops sizing and to draft the upsell worksheet. Per Diana's ask, here's what we'll bring to the QBR and what we'll ship week of Jul 5: 

Deliverables (week of Jul 5):
- Draft MLA (Renewal_MLA_draft_v3.pdf) with 12/24 month pricing exhibits.
- Upsell worksheet showing cost delta for +20% seats and burst pricing for 3x peak (hourly burst rate + estimated monthly charge).
- QBR_Agenda_Jul20.docx updated with Tom's sizing session and a technical deep-dive with Priyom.

Mutual action plan (MAP):
- By Jul 2: Confirm QBR attendees and finalize agenda.
- By Jul 5: Redwood shares draft MLA + pricing exhibits.
- By Jul 12: BrightPath legal provides redlines.
- Jul 20: QBR and finalize commercial term.
- Jul 26: DocuSign execution target.

Attachments: Renewal_MLA_draft_v3.pdf (for initial legal read), QBR_Agenda_Jul20.docx

If that timeline looks good I can also open the DocuSign envelope for the 24-month option in parallel so legal has a clean view of the commercial terms as they mark up the MLA.

Thanks — Marissa
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightPath renewal: term and capacity alignment + QBR scheduling

Great — thanks all for the quick responses. Confirming:
- QBR booked for Tue, Jul 20 at 10:00 AM PT (calendar invite sent: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=brightpath-qbr-20270720).
- Redwood to deliver the draft MLA and pricing exhibits on Mon, Jul 5. Marissa will open a DocuSign for the 24-month option as discussed.
- Priyom will run the technical sizing section during the QBR; Tom, please send any telemetry or peak window examples beforehand so we can model burst charges accurately.

Next steps for BrightPath:
1) Confirm final attendee list for Jul 20 by Jul 2.
2) Legal to expect Renewal_MLA_draft_v3.pdf on Jul 5; please send redlines by Jul 12.

If anything changes to the timeslots, flag it here and we'll adjust. Looking forward to the review and continuing the partnership.

Best,
Alex Martinez
